$comment: Deliberate deviations from the Figma export, applied by `npm run tokens:build` (it prints every override it applies). Each entry needs `$reason` with the design decision and its date (e.g. "Design 2026-10-23: …"); without such a decision Figma wins. Format: { "<group>": { "<field>": { "$reason": "…", "<style or *>": value } } }, e.g. typography.lineHeight["headline/medium"]. Empty since 2026-10-23: Figma text styles were aligned with the app.
